newsitem.title: USA: A.D. Tech sees Q1 revs higher than year-ago.
newsitem.headline: A.D. Tech sees Q1 revs higher than year-ago.

text.p: Advanced Deposition Technologies Inc said Monday its projected revenues for the first quarter of 1997 are up by more than 30 percent over a year ago.

The "signficantly greater" revenues are due to sales of its product 'Brown 'N Crisp', it said. The product is used in microwave cooking and promoted through infomercials, according to a company spokesperson.
The company said it invented 'Brown 'N Crisp' three years ago and has exclusive patent rights to produce and sell the product worldwide.
